audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].side and phases[6].side both said 'Skill' while win[5] and win[6] said 'Aurelion Sol' — the same two rows answering differently in the two layers.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol's first-item and two-item rows are where the 51.95% over 231 games comes from; the content layer already had it right.
audit.corrected: Both full-layer rows flipped to 'Aurelion Sol'. Rows 0-4 left with Annie in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3], whys[6] and late claimed 'global Comet presence', a '5-star ultimate' and a '5-star Comet ultimate'. spikes[1] describes Tibbers as 'a second stun source'.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol has no global ability and no Comet spell; his R is 1250 range. Tibbers' own listed CC is the ult cast's stun on impact, not a separate on-demand stun from the bear, so 'stun-adjacent' in mid was left but the spike text was not expanded on.
audit.corrected: Late spike rekeyed to stacked stardust and The Skies Descend; first-item spike keyed to Rod of Ages.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two decisive interactions of this lane appeared nowhere: Pyromania's stun cancels Breath of Light and Astral Flight (both interruptible channels), and Aurelion Sol out-ranges Annie's entire kit — beam 750 against Disintegrate 625, Incinerate 600, Summon: Tibbers 600.
audit.why: ownerKit Q and W both carry channel: 'interruptible — any CC cancels it'; enemyKit P carries hardCC. Riot's Pyromania text is 'After casting 4 spells' — spell casts, not auto-attacks — and 'Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available', so the stun is live on wave one. Molten Shield (E, 10s) also 'damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells'.
audit.corrected: early now states the cast-count rule, the wave-one availability and the range gap; dontsFull[2] states the channel cancel plus Molten Shield's return damage; breakdown.carry makes spacing the win condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers and a name-swappable 'fifth summoner spell' line.
audit.why: Summon: Tibbers is 130s at rank 1 and only 600 range; Astral Flight is 22s and is the specific answer to a Flash-Tibbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.carry, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d and enemyWin were name-swappable templates. early also stated Pyromania loads off 'spells or autos'.
audit.why: Riot's text credits spell casts only; the templated fields would read identically against any enemy.
audit.corrected: Grounded in the 625/600 range profile, the Flash-Tibbers commit, and the cast count.

edits.before: Annie wins by landing Summon: Tibbers, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Annie wins by loading Pyromania, closing to 625 with Flash, and stunning your channel dead before the burst even starts.

edits.before: - Annie Summon: Tibbers: matchup-defining — Flash-Tibbers off a stocked passive stun is her whole threat — watch the glow under her feet. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Astral Flight like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Annie Summon: Tibbers: 130s at rank 1, 600 range — Flash-Tibbers off a stocked Pyromania is her whole threat, so watch the glow under her feet and count her casts. - Astral Flight, 22s, is the answer to that Flash. - Falling Star: kill windows only.

edits.before: Carry by scaling honestly — every stardust stack is permanent, and the 30-minute version of you wins fights your laning self cannot imagine.
edits.after: Carry by spacing: everything she owns lands inside 625, your beam reaches 750, and Astral Flight covers the Flash gap she needs to close it.

edits.before: W-flyby: fly a lateral arc, drag Q across Annie for two seconds of burn + stacks, and land outside his answer range — repeat forever from one item.
edits.after: Falling Star answers a Flash-Tibbers commit: she has spent Flash to reach 600, and a stun there strands her in your black hole with no exit.

edits.before: Channelling Q face-to-face inside his engage range with W down — every champion that touches you wins that exchange pre-items.
edits.after: A loaded Pyromania cancels the channel outright, and Molten Shield returns damage for the trouble — count her casts before you beam.

edits.before: Two-item global presence and ultimate burst outscale her single-combo kit in extended fights
edits.after: Two items of stardust scaling and 1250-range zoning outscale her single-combo kit in fights

edits.before: Annie's stacked Pyromania stun turns any short trade into a full burst combo you cannot shield or Comet your way out of.
edits.after: A stacked Pyromania stun cancels your beam mid-channel and opens the full combo — but she must reach 625 to cast Disintegrate.

edits.before: Your first core item's burst lets you punish her for over-extending Tibbers without support back-up.
edits.after: Rod of Ages plus stardust ticks let you punish her for walking Tibbers up without support nearby.

edits.before: Your global Comet presence and 5-star ultimate outscale her single-combo burst kit once teamfights extend past the initial stun.
edits.after: Stacked stardust and The Skies Descend outscale her single-combo burst kit once teamfights extend past that opening stun.

edits.before: Annie's Pyromania passive means every four spells or autos loads an automatic stun, and if she catches you at the wrong stack count her Incinerate-Disintegrate combo can burst you down before your shield or star count matters. Your early kit has no way to interrupt or shield through the stun window itself. Track her ability usage closely, avoid clumping with minions when her stun is loaded, and play for farm rather than trades until you have more HP buffer.
edits.after: Annie loads Pyromania off four spell casts, and she starts the game with it available, so the very first wave already carries a stun that cancels your channel. Her whole kit is short — Disintegrate 625, Incinerate 600, Tibbers 600 — against a 750 beam, so she has to step to you to do anything at all. Track her cast count, hold that spacing whenever the stun is loaded, and farm rather than trade until your HP buffer is real.

edits.before: Tibbers adds a second stun-adjacent threat and sustained AoE damage on top of her point-and-click burst combo, so her all-in window at level 6 is one of the scariest in the lane. You're still surviving on positioning and cooldown-tracking here rather than winning trades. Bait her stun onto a minion or ward if possible, and never fight her when Pyromania is stacked and Tibbers is up simultaneously.
edits.after: Tibbers is 130s at rank 1 and lands stunned damage in a 600-range circle, so her level 6 all-in is one of the scariest in the lane — and Flash covers the last 400 units of it. You're still surviving on spacing and cast-counting rather than winning trades. Burn her Pyromania on a minion where you can, and never fight while it is stacked and Tibbers is up together.

edits.before: Once your first core item completes, your own burst finally punishes her for walking Tibbers forward without vision or support, since she has to commit fully to land her combo. By two items your global presence and 5-star Comet ultimate outscale her single-window burst kit, especially in extended fights where her combo is spent early. Force fights past her initial stun-burst and let your scaling take over.
edits.after: Once Rod of Ages completes, a held beam punishes her for walking Tibbers forward without vision, since she has to commit her whole 600-range combo to reach you at all. By two items The Skies Descend and your stardust curve outscale her single-window burst, especially in fights that last past her opening. Force the fight past that stun-burst and let the scaling take over.

notes: Riot's Pyromania text is 'After casting 4 spells' and 'Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available' — the old early text said 'spells or autos' and never mentioned that the stun is live on the first wave. The unstated structural fact of this lane is the range gap: Aurelion Sol's beam is 750 while Disintegrate is 625 and both Incinerate and Summon: Tibbers are 600, so every threat she has requires her to walk into a spell she cannot out-range. brief.missingInteractions was empty for this matchup; the channel-cancel and range findings come from the kit files directly.
